entry.title: Paged hub
entry.summary: A hub over its sidebar child cap that lists its pages two at a time, with a pagination below the list.
entry.content:
This hub has seven pages, a sidebar child cap of 3 and a page size of 2, set with sidebar_child_cap: 3 and hub_page_size: 2 in this page’s frontmatter. Seven is more than three, so the sidebar shows one “7 pages” entry, and seven is more than two, so this page lists its first two pages and the rest follow on listing pages 2, 3 and 4.

Use the pagination below the list to move between the listing pages. Each one is a page of its own, at /guides/paged-hub/page/2/ and so on.
